title: Pure Swordsoul
summary: Pure Swordsoul Wyrm Synchro deck centered on generating Level 4 Tuner Tokens to immediately forge Level 8 and 10 Synchro bosses, omitting the Tenyi and Branded engines. Supported by Incredible Ecclesia and archetype Spells, every Swordsoul monster functions as a self-contained Synchro engine that draws, mills, or burns on summon.

summary.title: Starters
points: Swordsoul of Mo Ye reveals a Swordsoul card or Wyrm monster in hand on Normal or Special Summon to Special Summon 1 Swordsoul Token, and draws 1 card when sent to the GY as Synchro Material.

Swordsoul of Taia banishes 1 Swordsoul card or Wyrm monster from your GY on summon to Special Summon 1 Swordsoul Token, and sends 1 Swordsoul card or Wyrm monster from Deck to GY when used as Synchro Material.
Swordsoul Strategist Longyuan discards 1 other Swordsoul card or Wyrm monster to Special Summon itself and 1 Swordsoul Token, and inflicts 1200 burn damage when used as Synchro Material.
Swordsoul Emergence adds a Swordsoul monster from your Deck to your hand, or searches any Wyrm monster if you control a Synchro Monster.
Incredible Ecclesia, the Virtuous Special Summons itself from hand while your opponent controls more monsters, and tributes itself as a Quick Effect to summon Mo Ye or Taia directly from your Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Mo Ye + Any Swordsoul or Wyrm
steps: Normal Summon Swordsoul of Mo Ye and reveal a Swordsoul card or Wyrm monster in your hand to Special Summon a Level 4 Swordsoul Token.
Synchro Summon Swordsoul Grandmaster - Chixiao using Mo Ye and the Token.
Chain Link 1 Chixiao to search Swordsoul Strategist Longyuan; Chain Link 2 Mo Ye to draw 1 card.
Activate Swordsoul Strategist Longyuan in hand, discarding a Swordsoul card or Wyrm to Special Summon itself and a Level 4 Swordsoul Token.
Synchro Summon Swordsoul Sinister Sovereign - Qixing Longyuan or Swordsoul Supreme Sovereign - Chengying, burning for 1200 damage off Longyuan.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Swordsoul Grandmaster - Chixiao adds or banishes a Swordsoul card on Synchro Summon, and banishes a Swordsoul card or Wyrm from hand or GY as a Quick Effect to negate 1 face-up effect monster on the field until the end of the turn.
The Three Champions of Swordsoul adds a Spellcaster with equal ATK and DEF from Deck to hand on summon, and banishes a Wyrm or Spellcaster from GY to negate an opponent's card.
Swordsoul Sinister Sovereign - Qixing Longyuan banishes an opponent's Special Summoned monster and burns for 1200 damage, and banishes an activated Spell/Trap and burns for 1200 damage.

Swordsoul Supreme Sovereign - Chengying gains 100 ATK/DEF for each banished card while debuffing opposing monsters, protects itself by banishing a card from GY, and banishes 1 card from both the opponent's field and GY whenever cards are banished.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Swordsoul Blackout is a Normal Trap that destroys 1 Wyrm monster you control and 2 cards your opponent controls, and spawns a Swordsoul Token when banished.
Swordsoul Sacred Summit targets and Special Summons a Swordsoul monster from your GY, or any Wyrm monster if you control a Synchro Monster.
Swordsoul Strife and Swordsoul Assessment banish cards or boost ATK, each spawning a Swordsoul Token when banished from the GY.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Archnemeses Protos is Forbidden in the TCG, and Tenyi wyrm extenders and Branded fusion engines are left out in favor of pure Swordsoul consistency.
